issues.description: The Client.assembleBookstore function is specified in the problem statement (and suggested in the template) to create and return a Bookstore, but in the solution repository the function signature is declared to return String while it actually returns a Bookstore instance. This creates a type mismatch that will not compile and will confuse students about the expected return type of assembleBookstore.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the assembleBookstore function signature in the solution to return Bookstore (private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore) so it matches the problem statement and the template's intended signature. Ensure the function's return type and its return expression are consistent. Optionally, verify the template's commented signature remains -> Bookstore to keep all artifacts consistent.
